OriginalGroupInformation.name: Original Group Information
OriginalGroupInformation.definition: Provides information on the original message.

OriginalRequestIdentification.name: Original Request Identification
OriginalRequestIdentification.definition: Identification of the original CashDepositRequest or CashWithdrawalRequest or CashDepositOrWithdrawalCancellationRequest.

RequestHandling.name: Request Handling
RequestHandling.definition: Provides the status of the request.

CashDepositValidation.name: Cash Deposit Validation
CashDepositValidation.definition: Confirmation of how the cash receiver has validated the cash deposit.

CashWithdrawalConfirmation.name: Cash Withdrawal Confirmation
CashWithdrawalConfirmation.definition: Confirmation of the note and cash denominations used by the cash sender for the cash withdrawal.
